title: Causal Inference under Interference with Learned Exposure Mappings
abstract: arXiv:2608.19224v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Exposure mappings are often assumed to be known in causal spillover analyses. In environmental settings, however, they are typically induced by transport processes that are not directly observed and must instead be learned from pollution data. We study how uncertainty in learned transport processes propagates into exposure mappings and downstream spillover inference under interference. We compare mechanistic transport models with modern operator-learning approaches, including PDE, PINO, FNO, and GeoPT, using both simulation studies and an empirical analysis of California PM$_{2.5}$ data. In simulations, all four transport models achieved nearly identical pollution prediction accuracy, yet estimated spillover effects ranged from 1.78 to 2.27. Models that more accurately recovered the induced exposure mapping also produced spillover estimates closer to the true effect. Disagreement was modest for regional interventions but substantially

translated_title: 基于学习暴露映射下的干扰因果推断
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.19224v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：在因果溢出分析中，暴露映射通常被假定为已知。然而，在环境背景下，它们通常由未直接观测的传输过程引发，必须从污染数据中学习。我们研究了学习到的传输过程中的不确定性如何传播到暴露映射及下游干扰下的溢出推断。我们比较了机理传输模型与现代算子学习方法，包括PDE、PINO、FNO和GeoPT，使用模拟研究和加利福尼亚州PM2.5数据的实证分析。在模拟中，所有四种传输模型在污染预测准确性上几乎相同，但估计的溢出效应范围从1.78到2.27。更准确恢复诱导暴露映射的模型产生的溢出估计更接近真实效应。对于区域干预，差异较小，但对于其他情况则显著。
tldr: 本研究首次系统比较了多种传输模型在因果推断中的表现，发现即使污染预测精度相似，不同模型对暴露映射的恢复程度会导致溢出效应估计出现显著差异，强调了暴露映射学习准确性对因果推断的关键作用。
en_tdlr: This study systematically compares multiple transport models in causal inference, revealing that even with similar pollution prediction accuracy, differences in recovering exposure mappings lead to substantial variation in spillover effect estimates, highlighting the critical role of exposure mapping learning accuracy.
